name: Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub
description: The Commercient Data Lake MCP connector gives Claude direct, secure access to your tenant's business data, enabling a wide range of data operations without leaving your workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://datalake-ms-dab.commercient.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub lists 23 MCP tools, including aggregate, create_record, delete_record, describe_entities, execute_entity, export_query, export_table, getAPIGuide, getHelpDocs, get_active_schema, get_document, and ingest_table.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercient Data Lake \ Data Hub is developed by Edgeware Commercient Team. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
